product_metadata.title: Household Essentials Cedar Fresh Cedar Rings, Pack of 6, Solid Eastern Red Cedar, Natural Moth and Odor Deterrent, Eco-Friendly and Chemical-Free, Perfect for Wire and Plastic Hangers, Natural
features: These cedar rings are a Cedar Fresh solution that will help protect your clothing from moth damage and odor without the need for harmful chemicals or dyes.
Made from 100% eastern red cedar, this pack of 6 cedar rings fit over most hanger hooks as a smart solution to any moth problem.
Use these cedar rings for their natural moth deterrent properties and fresh cedar smell. The rings can be inserted over hanger hooks or stowed away inside drawers or suitcases.
Their rounded edges and smooth grain reduces snagging and increases their natural potency over a larger surface area
description: These Cedar Fresh cedar rings are a compact and natural solution to stale closets and pesky moths. Made of solid eastern red cedar, which is sourced from sustainable forests, this pack of 6 cedar rings is not only environmentally friendly but better for your overall health. While other moth repellent products are made with harsh chemicals, these eco-friendly cedar rings are made with all-natural materials that deter moths and bring the refreshing scent of cedar into your home. These discs are 2 inches wide with an insert large enough to fit over most wire and plastic hanger hooks. No need to worry about rounding-up scattered mothballs, simply insert these cedar rings over the hangers of your choice for quick and easy moth repellent. These cedar rings are perfect for delicate clothing. They are non-staining and have smooth rounded edges to discourage snagging. The circular design increases surface area and allows them to remain compact but potent. Not only does cedar have natural moth repellent properties, but it will also keep your closet and attire smelling fresh. This pack of 6 cedar rings is primarily meant for use in the closet, but they can also be used inside dresser drawers, suitcases, chests and more. Introduce smart, eco-friendly alternatives into your home with the inclusion of these cedar rings in the entryway closet or bedroom closet. They are especially great for closets that lack shelving or have limited space..
